# PEACH STUDIO

> Creative AI studio building innovative products, autonomous agents, and digital experiences. Based in Everberg, Belgium.

## About

PEACH STUDIO is a creative AI studio founded by Vito Rallo, a cybersecurity expert with 25+ years of experience. We build products, not services. Our focus areas include Creative AI & Agentic Development, AI & Cybersecurity Keynotes, Business Workflow Automation, Game Development, 3D Art & Design, and Video Production.

## Products

- [Macframe](https://peachstudio.be/macframe/): IBM Mainframe emulator for macOS. Run MVS 3.8J on your Mac with a single click. Native Apple Silicon support. Free for personal and educational use.
- [Business Profiler](https://peachstudio.be/profilers/): Claude Code plugin for cybersecurity threat intelligence, attack surface assessment, and strategic sales targeting. 7 skills, 16 scripts, PDF reports. Free and open source (MIT License).

## Founder

Vito Rallo - Cybersecurity expert, AI Security Researcher, and keynote speaker. Former Red Team head at Kroll, Director at PwC, Senior Engineer at IBM. 25+ years in the industry.
